_about: Confederation for teams that Fjelstul's teams.csv does not cover (2026 debutants, and DR Congo, which Fjelstul only has as Zaire). Every other team's confederation comes from teams.csv confederation_code. A team's region on the country list is its lineage root's confederation. Source: each federation's FIFA membership (CAF, CONCACAF, AFC), checked 2026-09-11.
